Include all requested counts and provenance fields. Explain the query result in ordinary prose; do not emit placeholder text. These questions concern a static map of open-source Python code. Describe what the query computes and the assumptions it makes; the returned rows are reported separately. Questions asking which files, modules or symbols mean distinct identities, not one repeated row per matching import or call occurrence; preserve occurrence counts only when requested. Caller/callee graph questions include methods as well as standalone functions unless a symbol kind is explicitly restricted. Use files.is_test for test-file classification; test_links describe associations, not the complete set of test files. gold_sql:
WITH RECURSIVE impact(symbol_id, depth, path) AS (
  SELECT c.caller_symbol_id, 1, '|' || t.symbol_id || '|' || c.caller_symbol_id || '|'
  FROM code.calls c
  JOIN code.symbols t ON t.symbol_id = c.callee_symbol_id
  WHERE t.name = 'resolve_semantic_fks'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT c.caller_symbol_id, i.depth + 1, i.path || c.caller_symbol_id || '|'
  FROM code.calls c
  JOIN impact i ON c.callee_symbol_id = i.symbol_id
  WHERE strpos(i.path, '|' || c.caller_symbol_id || '|') = 0
)
SELECT i.symbol_id, MIN(i.depth) AS depth
FROM impact i
JOIN code.symbols s ON s.symbol_id = i.symbol_id
JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = s.file_id
WHERE NOT f.is_test
GROUP BY i.symbol_id
ORDER BY depth, i.symbol_id;
